intro:
Deep in space, you find something glowing.$It hums with a serene sound…
Up close, it’s a sleeping Jirachi!
title: Wish on a Star
description:
Jirachi, said to wake for only seven days every thousand years, is fast asleep. Wake it gently with a song, and it might grant you a wish.
A Pokémon that knows {{wishMoveName}} or {{healingWishMoveName}} makes the wish even bigger.

1.label: Sing It Awake
1.disabledTooltip: A Pokémon needs a song, a sound or a waking move (or such an ability) to choose this.
1.selected:
Jirachi begins to shine
like a star…
1.sleep:
Its wish granted, Jirachi
falls back into a deep sleep…

2.label: Shake It Awake
2.tooltip:
(-) Hard Battle with an Angry Jirachi
(+) Special Rewards
2.selected:
You shake the sleeping Jirachi
until it wakes up!$Jirachi opens its eyes, furious!
2.statBoost: Jirachi is furious at being woken up!

3.label: Leave
3.selected:
You quietly walk away so as
not to wake the sleeping Jirachi.

wishPrompt:
{{option1PrimaryName}}’s {{option1PrimaryWakeSound}} woke Jirachi!
What will you wish for?

wish.bonus:
{{wishPokemon}}’s {{wishMove}} shines along!
The wish grows bigger!

wealth.label: Wish for Wealth
wealth.result:
Money comes raining down from the sky!
You received {{wealthMoney}}!

power.label: Wish for Power
power.tooltip:
One Pokémon you pick gets IV Candies
for {{powerStats}} of its stats.
power.full:
{{pokemonName}} can’t take
any more IV Candies!

health.label: Wish for Health
health.tooltipBonus:
Fully heal your party and
receive a {{healingCharm}}.
health.result:
Jirachi’s light wraps around your party!
All your Pokémon are healed!
